label: Shader buttons
desc: Five different live-drawn call-to-action buttons (plasma and holographic fragment shaders, ignition embers, a particle constellation, a tactile brushed plate) chosen with `variant`; hover, focus and press drive the animation.
use: Primary call to action on a hero or pricing card; pick one variant per page, not all five.

label: Rectangle buttons
desc: Ten distinct CSS-only rectangular call-to-action treatments (glass, gradient border, keycap, dotted border, technical outline, arrow pill, halftone bloom, inset arrow chip, hard-shadow stamp, fill sweep) via `variant`; renders a button or a link.
use: Calls to action, form submits and link buttons; choose one variant to match the page's tone.

label: Circle buttons
desc: Circular icon controls (play/pause, plus, mail with a send animation) in three treatments: glass, dotted ring and tactile dome.
use: Media controls, floating add actions and send buttons; always pass an aria-label.

label: Liquid metal button
desc: A WebGL liquid-chrome button in pill and orb shapes: a bevelled reflective rim with edge dispersion, a flowing dark face, hover bloom and a click ripple, with a CSS chrome fallback.
use: A premium hero call to action or play button on a dark section.

label: Character carousel
desc: An editorial profile-card carousel in two layouts, a flat filmstrip and a perspective wave, with invented illustrated characters; drag, wheel, arrows and keyboard, looping.
use: Team, cast or testimonial profiles on an about page; pass your own `items`.

label: Image ribbon
desc: A spiral ribbon of curved artwork panels orbiting in CSS 3D, built from narrow slices; drag or arrow keys turn it and a button pauses it.
use: A gallery or portfolio hero (fills its parent).

label: Engraved certificate
desc: A certificate drawn in SVG with a woven guilloche border, rosette watermark and seal, lathe-line paper and set type; the lines draw in once and a sheen follows the pointer.
use: Award, course-completion or membership pages; pass recipient, citation and issuer.

label: Diagnostics panel
desc: A diagnostics card with three Canvas 2D illustrations (stacked layer planes, a node cube, a rippling mesh) chosen with an accessible tab list.
use: System, model or network health screens; a dashboard tile that explains structure with a moving diagram.

label: Skeuomorphic toggle
desc: A real switch (role=switch) in four takes: a metal knob in a recessed slot with an LED, a tilting rocker paddle, a flat pill and a flat segmented control.
use: Settings panels and preference lists; pick tactile for hardware-flavoured products, flat for everything else.

label: Wireframe forms
desc: A rotating wireframe cube, three crossing cylinders or a latitude/longitude sphere drawn on a canvas with depth-faded lines; drag to spin, arrow keys nudge.
use: A technical hero accent or empty-state illustration (fills its parent).

label: Status orbs
desc: Animated dot-orb status indicators for Thinking, Uploading, Listening and Idle in 20px and 56px sizes with primary, signal, aurora and mono colour styles.
use: Inline with a status line (small) or as the centrepiece of an assistant or upload state (medium).
